notes.title: Demo Patch: Bug Fix
notes.content:
In Donke We Trust!
With a new patch of demo we fixed belowing known bugs;

-Death screen and ESC menu can overlap
-Game stays frozen after restart button is pressed
-Some indicators on weapon customization are now logical
-Charge weapon doesn't make a sound while charging

These bugs came from our players. We would love to thank them for their contributing to development process. 
If you found a bug or have a feedback/suggestion please reach us on Discord;
